name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-super-mario-land-enemies-pack
title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Land Enemies Pack
description:
This is a pack that contains graphics for most of Super Mario Land 1 enemies in Redrawn style.
A lot of them have custom sprites in the site made by smkdan (Gunion replaces the Sunshine Blooper)

Since the site does not accept enemies without corresponding sprites, these have been included in my profile files.
